probes.question: About how many Earths could fit inside the Sun?

image.alt: The sun emitted a mid-level solar flare, an M7.9-class, peaking at 4:16 a.m. EDT on June 25, 2015. NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory, which watches the sun constantly, captured an image of the event.

body.question: About how many Earths could fit inside the Sun?
body.reveal: About 1.3 million Earths would fit inside the Sun by volume.
